# 0.6.1 beta 5 — Announcement language and bounded window-opening requests

- Add a consistent **Announcement language** menu in General settings and the
  delivery setup, with the same choice available as **Announcement · Language**
  on the **Home Environment** device.
- Default to **Home Assistant language** and offer all **38 languages supported
  by HEM**, using their native names. The menu remains available without a TTS
  provider and does not lose choices when the provider changes.
- Resolve the default against Home Assistant's current configured language when
  each announcement is sent. Apply the choice consistently to announcement
  text, AI rewriting, Announcement Hub and direct TTS.
- Preserve Brazilian Portuguese and Chinese script distinctions, and match TTS
  providers' exact language tags. A provider that cannot speak the selected
  language uses the existing delivery error handling instead of silently
  substituting a different language. Text notifications remain available.
- Complete the compact shade, away-window, physical-device-fault and
  ventilation reminder templates for all supported languages. Keep room,
  device and window names, and original device diagnostic details, unchanged.
- Preserve existing supported language choices, native entity identities, announcement
  destinations, channel selections and Announcement Hub's delivery ownership.
  Add regressions for the menu, persistence, locale matching, templates and
  actual announcement service payloads.
- Evaluate useful indoor ventilation needs even when outside conditions need
  caution. Include each detected weather, temperature, wind, moisture or air
  quality concern in a conditional request; preserve the outdoor safety flag
  used by automatic outside-air devices. Do not propose a humidity/pollutant
  benefit contradicted by comparable outdoor measurements.
- Keep useful manual airing from immediately being countermanded solely by
  cold, heat, high outdoor humidity, ordinary rain or fog. Request closure when
  the benefit ends; severe hazards and the room temperature/energy protections
  retain their close advice.
- Offer physically supported window alternatives before an eligible device
  starts, including cold-weather drying with an explicit heat-loss caution.
- Add **Window opening timeout**, default **5 minutes**, configurable from
  **0–30 minutes** in General and on the Home Environment device. Defer only
  eligible new automatic/PID conditioning starts with room window protection
  enabled. Bound announcement submission, release immediately after failure,
  and start the response deadline only on accepted delivery. Repeats do not
  extend it. An opened contact retains the normal window interlock; timeout
  allows normal demand-based control again.
- Send actionable opening requests to Announcement Hub at **warning** level.
  Optional wake/return reminders retain **info**. Preserve complete caution
  and response-time wording, and bound direct output calls to avoid stuck
  submissions.
- Send the first stable opening recommendation after startup even when repeat
  reminders are disabled. Keep separate visible states for request submission,
  waiting for opening, and the existing open/unknown-window protections.

Install the new beta and restart Home Assistant. Open **Configure → General
settings → Announcement language**, or the **Home Environment** device's
**Announcement · Language** control. New configurations use Home Assistant's
language automatically; existing explicit language choices are retained.
Spoken output requires a TTS provider that supports the chosen language.
Existing releases, assets and tags are retained.
